meta.name: Dreamland
meta.description: Ever since his mother died in a fire, Terrence has drifted through life in a fog of apathy, terrified by any flame. The same nightmare haunts him every night, until he finally confronts his phobia. By overcoming his fear, Terrence becomes a Voyager, able to command fire and cross into Dreamland, the mysterious dimension where humanity's dreams and nightmares come to life.

videos.title: Terrence
videos.overview: Terrorized by fiery nightmares, Terrence discovers a new world after overcoming his greatest fear.

videos.title: Voyageur
videos.overview: Terrence freaks out after realizing he left something important behind and meets new friends and foes.

videos.title: Savane
videos.overview: Terrence gains a new ally in the fight against the nightmare cats terrorizing Dreamer's Field.

videos.title: Sabba
videos.overview: After a night of partying, Terrence and Savane get caught up in a battle for the Paintbrush of Destiny.

videos.title: Eve
videos.overview: When a circus exploits a dreamer, Terrence supports her even though she hates his guts.

videos.title: Edenia
videos.overview: Terrence finds a new goal in Dreamland, and Savane tests his new invocations in a duel.
